result.stdout:
Usage: [command] [-h|--help] [--version]

Commands:
  add         Add a new migration with an EF-style ID (yyyyMMddHHmmss_Name).
  bundle      Build a single executable that applies the migrations without the .NET SDK or this tool.
  list        List the migrations in the project, without connecting to a database.
  migrate     Apply pending migrations, or those up to and including a target.
  remove      Remove the latest migration's source file, after checking it isn't applied to the database.
  rollback    Roll back the last applied migration, or every applied migration after a target.
  status      List the migrations and whether each is applied.

result.stdout:
Usage: add [arguments...] [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Add a new migration with an EF-style ID (yyyyMMddHHmmss_Name).

Arguments:
  [0] <string>    The migration name, e.g. OrdersAddDeletedAt; it becomes the class name.

Options:
  --project <string?>         The project holding the migrations (a .csproj or its directory); the current directory by default. [Default: null]
  --output-dir <string?>      The folder, relative to the project, to write the migration to; next to the latest migration (or Migrations) by default. [Default: null]
  --configuration <string>    The build configuration. [Default: @"Debug"]
  --id <string?>              Use this ID instead of a timestamp-based one. [Default: null]

result.stdout:
Usage: bundle [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Build a single executable that applies the migrations without the .NET SDK or this tool.

Options:
  --project <string?>         The project holding the migrations (a .csproj or its directory); the current directory by default. [Default: null]
  --configuration <string>    The build configuration. [Default: @"Release"]
  --runtime <string?>         The target runtime identifier, e.g. linux-x64 or linux-arm64; the current one by default. [Default: null]
  --self-contained            Include the .NET runtime, so the target machine needs none.
  --output <string?>          The output file or directory; cosmos-migrations-bundle in the current directory by default. [Default: null]
  --force                     Overwrite an existing bundle.

Options:

result.stdout:
Usage: migrate [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Apply pending migrations, or those up to and including a target.

Options:
  --target <string?>               The last migration to apply: its ID, or an EF-style ID's timestamp or name. [Default: null]
  --project <string?>              The project holding the migrations (a .csproj or its directory); the current directory by default. [Default: null]
  --assembly <string?>             A prebuilt or published migrations assembly, instead of building a project. [Default: null]
  --configuration <string>         The build configuration. [Default: @"Debug"]
  --no-build                       Use the existing build output of the project.
  --connection-string <string?>    The Cosmos DB connection string or account endpoint; also read from COSMOS_MIGRATIONS_CONNECTION_STRING. [Default: null]
  --connection-name <string?>      Read the connection string from ConnectionStrings__<name>, as .NET Aspire sets it. [Default: null]
  --database <string?>             The database to migrate; also read from COSMOS_MIGRATIONS_DATABASE. [Default: null]
  --container <string?>            The container recording applied migrations. [Default: null]
  --lock-timeout <int?>            Seconds to wait for another runner's lease. [Default: null]
  --verbose                        Log debug output.
